title: 100STYLE idles
legend: Readable key poses (the my-3D2dge format). Times in seconds; every other number is a whole number. Rig frame: forward, right, up.
L and R are the figure's own sides. Directions are percentages and need not add up: [100, 0, 0] and [50, 0, 0] agree.
hips   [forward, right, up]   the pelvis, in percent of standing hip height (100 = standing, 55 = sitting on a chair)
body   [turn, lean, tilt]     the pelvis, degrees: turn + = toward the right, lean + = forward, tilt + = toward the right
chest  [turn, lean, tilt]     the chest, relative to the pelvis; head [turn, lean, tilt] relative to the chest
shL shR    [reach, shrug]     degrees the shoulder swings forward (into a punch or an aim) and up, from rest

armL armR  [forward, out, up, bend, twist]  which way the arm points from the shoulder to the fist, in chest space (out + = away from the body on that side; [0, 0, -100] hangs down, [100, 0, 0] punches ahead); bend = elbow bend in degrees (0 = straight); twist = degrees the elbow swings round the arm from its natural direction (back and down)
legL legR  [forward, out, up, bend, twist]  hip to ankle in pelvis space; bend: the knee; twist: from pointing forward
footL footR [down, out, toes]   degrees the foot points down from standing, turns outward, and the toes bend up
blade  [forward, right, up]   (sword clips) the direction of a blade held in the right fist, in chest space
root   [forward, right]       (clips that travel) how far the whole body has moved, in percent of standing hip height
speed  (a clip's header: loops that walk or run in place) how fast the capture travelled, percent of standing hip height a second

100STYLE.origin: The 100STYLE dataset: one performer walking, running, sidestepping and idling in 100 styles, captured by Ian Mason, Sebastian Starke and Taku Komura (Real-Time Style Modelling of Human Locomotion via Feature-Wise Transformations and Local Motion Phases, 2022). Each clip is standing in the style: the longest stretch where the hips stay put, cut at its best cycle (2.5 s at least: breathing and weight shifts, not a twitch), inside the frames the dataset marks as the style.

Aeroplane_Idle.desc: Standing, aeroplane style: both arms raised as wings – tilting from side to side

Akimbo_Idle.desc: Standing, akimbo style: hands on hips

Angry_Idle.desc: Standing, angry style: swing lower arms aggressively - fists closed

ArmsAboveHead_Idle.desc: Standing, arms above head style: arms raised straight above head

ArmsBehindBack_Idle.desc: Standing, arms behind back style: hands clasped behind back

ArmsBySide_Idle.desc: Standing, arms by side style: keep arms fixed by side and do not move them

ArmsFolded_Idle.desc: Standing, arms folded style: right arm folded over left

Balance_Idle.desc: Standing, balance style: arms out to side for balance - tilting side to side

BeatChest_Idle.desc: Standing, beat chest style: beat chest while moving normally

BentForward_Idle.desc: Standing, bent forward style: tilt torso forwards

BentKnees_Idle.desc: Standing, bent knees style: bend knees as much as possible

BigSteps_Idle.desc: Standing, big steps style: as large steps as possible

BouncyRight_Idle.desc: Standing, bouncy right style: step normally with left foot but spring off right foot

Chicken_Idle.desc: Standing, chicken style: bob head - arms as wings

Depressed_Idle.desc: Standing, depressed style: head bowed arms swinging

LeanBack_Idle.desc: Standing, lean back style: bent backwards

LeanLeft_Idle.desc: Standing, lean left style: normal motion upperbody tilted right

LeftHop_Idle.desc: Standing, left hop style: hop on left foot

LegsApart_Idle.desc: Standing, legs apart style: legs relatively straight wide apart

LookUp_Idle.desc: Standing, look up style: tilt head to look at ceiling
